title: Do Not Retreat
setup: White has just kicked your knight with the h-pawn and, four hundred points up, fully expects you to move it back.
hint: Your knight on g4 is attacked, so stop defending it and ask what your other knight could hit instead.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nd4}} ignores the attacked knight and hits the queen on e2, the one piece holding both the bishop on c4 and the knight on f3.

White's best is {{hxg4}}, and {{Nxe2+}} takes the queen. Two knights for a queen leaves you a clean piece ahead.

The natural capture is far worse. After {{Nxd4}} the knight that guarded h2 has left, and {{Qh2#}} ends it, with the knight on g4 guarding the queen.

When a piece is attacked, look for a bigger attack before you look for a square.
